title: Final candidate D01 with a 0.5 s input window (50 samples instead of 20)
hypothesis: A teammate reported that a 500 ms window helped the original pipeline. A longer history might also help D01, although X06 (0.4 s on the baseline) was worse at Stage A.
motivation: One change relative to D01 (window only), all 6 subjects, so the window question is answered for our final approach.
